# Reachdesk
> Reachdesk is a global B2B gifting and swag platform that lets companies send personalized gifts and direct mail to prospects, customers, and employees to build relationships and drive measurable results.
## Platform
- [Platform overview](https://www.reachdesk.com/overview): Full tour of the Reachdesk gifting and swag platform.
- [Personalized gifting](https://www.reachdesk.com/personalized-gifting): Scaling personalized B2B gifting with AI.
- [Integrations](https://www.reachdesk.com/integrations): Connecting Reachdesk to your CRM, marketing, and sales stack.
- [Global warehousing](https://www.reachdesk.com/global-warehousing): Worldwide warehousing and fulfillment for swag and gifts.
- [Swag management](https://www.reachdesk.com/swag-management): Managing and distributing branded swag globally.
- [Reporting](https://www.reachdesk.com/reporting): Tracking ROI and gifting campaign performance.
- [Budgeting](https://www.reachdesk.com/budgeting): Controlling and managing corporate gifting budgets.
- [Creative services](https://www.reachdesk.com/creative-services): Creative strategy and design for gifting campaigns.
- [Events fulfillment](https://www.reachdesk.com/events-fulfillment): Gifting and fulfillment for events.
## Solutions by team
- [Marketing](https://www.reachdesk.com/marketing): Gifting for ABM, demand gen, and field marketing teams.
- [Sales](https://www.reachdesk.com/sales): Booking more meetings with gift automation.
- [Customer success](https://www.reachdesk.com/customer-success): Gifting to retain and grow accounts.
- [HR & people](https://www.reachdesk.com/people): Gifting for HR and people teams.
- [Employee engagement](https://www.reachdesk.com/employee-engagement): Boosting employee engagement with gifts.
## Pricing & customers
- [Pricing](https://www.reachdesk.com/pricing): Reachdesk pricing and plans.
- [Customer stories](https://www.reachdesk.com/customers/salesloft): How Salesloft drove 60x ROI with personalized gifting.
## Resources
- [Resources](https://www.reachdesk.com/resources): Guides, articles, and content library.
- [Ebooks](https://www.reachdesk.com/ebooks): Downloadable ebooks on B2B gifting.
## Optional
- [Field & event marketing](https://www.reachdesk.com/marketing/field-event-marketing)
- [Marketing operations](https://www.reachdesk.com/marketing/marketing-operations)
- [Account-based marketing](https://www.reachdesk.com/marketing/account-based-marketing)
- [Demand generation](https://www.reachdesk.com/marketing/demand-generation)
- [Gifting for SDRs](https://www.reachdesk.com/sales/sales-development-representitive)
- [Gifting for AEs & AMs](https://www.reachdesk.com/sales/account-executives-and-account-managers)

Frequently asked questions
What is a region?
 
A region refers to a major geographical area where Reachdesk provides fulfillment services. Pricing may vary depending on where you're shipping to or from, such as North America, EMEA, or APAC, based on warehousing, logistics, and local compliance standards.
Can I add additional regions or warehouses to my package?
 
Yes, our packages can be customized to your needs. If you’d like more regions, warehouses, or services, simply speak to your sales representative. If you’re already a customer, your Customer Success Manager can help make the necessary arrangements and provide details on any additional costs.
Where are Reachdesk’s warehouses located?
 
Reachdesk has a global network of state-of-the-art warehouses in the USA, Canada, the UK, Europe, and Australia. This ensures fast, reliable, and secure storage and shipping to over 180 countries. Whether you're sending corporate gifts, swag, or event materials, our streamlined fulfillment process keeps your items customs-compliant, free from hidden fees, and delivered on time.
What’s the difference between Creative Services and Swag Sourcing?
 
Swag Sourcing is ideal for bulk orders of standard items like apparel, tech gadgets, stationery, and other branded merchandise with basic customization options such as logos or colors. We offer this service with or without the Reachdesk platform. The minimum order is $2,500, and we manage vendor relationships for you so you don't have to.
Creative Services is a full-service solution where our team of gifting experts support you from start to finish. From campaign planning and messaging to gift creation and shipping, we work as an extension of your team to help you build impactful gifting experiences and bundles that align with your brand and campaign goals.
What is Event Fulfillment?
 
Event Fulfillment is our end-to-end solution for sourcing, shipping, and managing swag, materials, and small equipment for events. We ensure fast, reliable delivery to your venue or chosen location with a five-day domestic shipping window, even on tight deadlines. With over 1.1 million square feet of warehouse space across the US, UK, EU, Canada, and Australia, we provide secure storage and quick fulfillment.
Do you offer Event returns?
 
After your event in the US, UK, or EU, you can request a return label in Reachdesk’s app, pack up any leftovers, and send them back to your preferred location or one of our warehouses. We’ll handle the counting and storage to keep the process simple and stress-free.
Ready to accelerate your pipeline and boost marketing ROI by 5X?
Stop blending in. Start standing out. See how Reachdesk can help your team drive more revenue through smart, data-driven gifting.
